catalyst_rows.asset: VYKAT XR (diazoxide choline) via Soleno Therapeutics acquisition
catalyst_rows.raw_text: Entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Soleno Therapeutics for $53.00 per share in cash... The acquisition is anticipated to close in the second quarter of 2026.

extractor_notes.blockers: PR also lists Phase 3 osavampator (MDD) and direclidine (schizophrenia) programs but without specific dated milestones; Soleno acquisition close is only forward-dated date-stamped catalyst.
